variety._comment: Random-offer item pool ramp (Offers.ramp_progress / ramp_weight). Every ore type and every recipe item can be requested. Progress = (day - startDay) / (endDay - startDay), clamped 0-1; a candidate's weight = lerp(startWeights[class], 1, progress), so from endDay on the pick is uniform. Classes: pearl (timePearl), knownRecipe (other items the player knows), unknownRecipe, ore. Provisional numbers, tagged for balance.

assay._comment: Wren's assay commissions (Offers._maybe_assay_commission) -- provisional numbers, tagged for balance. Once flags[unlockFlag] is set, each day rolls chancePerDay for one pending offer from template (at most one pending at a time, inside the random-offer cap): qtyMin-qtyMax of a recipe item picked by the variety ramp, at rank >= the player's best rank for it (50/50 +1, capped at maxRank), paid at the quote x margin. A complete settlement also adds relation to the Guild. PROSE-REVIEW: notify, offerNote, rankSuffix.
assay.notify: Wren has a commission for you. Recipe, grade, date.
assay.offerNote: Assay commission. Deliver it all and the Guild remembers (+%d relation).
